verdict.rationale: The README states one per-model language difference: four of the six model sizes have English-only versions, while the rest are multilingual. It also shows a `--language` flag (e.g., Japanese) and describes multilingual recognition and translation into English. However, no concrete list of supported languages appears anywhere in the evidence, so the core of the story is unevidenced. missing for 10: a published concrete list of supported languages, per-language or per-feature differences (e.g., which languages support translation, or language support for API models like gpt-transcribe), and independent corroboration.
